title: Rav Zutra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Zutra said in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, “It is better for a person to throw himself into a fiery furnace than to humiliate his fellow in public.” Hyman cites [Berakhot 43a (43b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.43b.8). [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1088&lang=en) gives this attribution, and the author of Maskil LeEitan raised an outcry against him that it is not found there and argued there needlessly, in Hyman’s judgment, for that is the reading of Ein Yaakov there. Hyman considers it very likely that he is Rabbi Zutra the Babylonian Tanna.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives three alternate chains: Rav Zutra bar Toviyah in Rav’s name, Rav Chana bar Bizna in Rabbi Shimon Chasida’s name, or Rabbi Yochanan in Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai’s name. Heilprin’s linked entry gives the shorter Rav Zutra attribution. Hyman reports that Ein Yaakov reads that way and considers it very likely that the speaker was the Babylonian tanna.
